description: This file contains shell functions for managing firmware upgrades for GL.iNet devices, specifically handling NAND and NOR flash upgrade procedures, determining boot device switch status, and setting up the next boot configuration.

methods.name: glinet_using_boot_dev_switch
methods.description: Checks if the boot device switch is turned on by examining environment variable.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nand
methods.description: Prepares system to boot from NAND on next restart by updating environment variables.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nor
methods.description: Prepares system to boot from NOR flash on next restart by updating environment variables.

methods.name: glinet_nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Controller that executes appropriate upgrade procedure based on the target flash type (NAND or NOR).

methods.name: nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade process for NAND or NOR flash based on the provided upgrade file.
